§ 01 · The Program

Real moves,
real decisions.

From developing a competitive strategy and handling a disruption threat, to launching breakthrough innovations, leading a merger integration, and presenting recommendations to the board, every scenario drops you into a genuine strategy situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Forty-six foundations-focused scenarios and fifty-four enterprise-and-transformation-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real strategic judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a strategy or innovation leader faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across competitive strategy, innovation, M&A, digital disruption, and enterprise leadership.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound strategic judgment under real pressure.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Strategy Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping strategy and innovation leaders think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in strategy isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–C1 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, strategy and innovation roles in English — Mr. Gad Advanced Strategy & Innovation is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the strategic moments you'll actually face.
